scenario: `{p.body.x:.3}` (a precision with no type) on an Int leaf. With no type only a String takes a precision (LGRA.2.9.6.5), so at run time it is a TypeError (LGRA.2.9.6.11) and `handler` logs. PATH PINNED: the precision refusal on the canonical type in the interpolation renderer (libds `render_value`'s precision check, Mercury `ds.format.value_body`'s `ft_canonical` Int arm). The break is a rendering that drops the precision and logs `v 7`.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    P p
->
    log info "v {p.body.x:.3}"

rule handler:
    TypeError
->
    log info "type error"
